notes.title: Update v1.39 released
notes.content:
A small update has been released containing some changes and bug fixes. This update should support all savegames. Below is a list of the update details.

Changelog

- Balanced items given by chests as rewards.

Fixes

- Fixed a bug with loading the Monster.png file.
- Fixed a bug with the physics of map elements that allowed players to pass through unintended elements such as walls or columns.
- Fixed a bug with transports that sent the player to the wrong room in the first dungeon.
